info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Custom Reports API
info.description: Exposes Custom Reports configuration and reporting endpoints. Use it to create, duplicate, manage, and query custom report definitions and their archived data.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website that owns the source custom report.
(Required) The ID of the custom report to duplicate.

request.description: Duplicates a custom report to one or more websites.
